evidence.quote: by and between Sierra Crest General Contractors, Inc., a California corporation
evidence.rationale: Preamble names Sierra Crest General Contractors, Inc. as "Contractor".

evidence.quote: and Granite State Concrete, Inc., a California corporation
evidence.rationale: Preamble names Granite State Concrete, Inc. as "Subcontractor".

evidence.quote: Arts Foundation, a California nonprofit public benefit corporation ("Owner")
evidence.rationale: Recital identifies Pasadena Arts Foundation as Owner under the Prime Contract.

project.value: Colorado Boulevard Gallery Expansion, 1460 East Colorado Boulevard, Pasadena, California 91106

evidence.quote: known as the Colorado Boulevard Gallery Expansion, located at 1460 East Colorado Boulevard
evidence.rationale: Recital defines the Project.

evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of California
evidence.rationale: Section 14.4 selects California law.

evidence.quote: Contractor has no obligation to pay Subcontractor any sum for Subcontract Work, whether as a progress payment, retention, or final payment, unless and until Contractor has actually received payment from Owner for that Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 conditions any payment obligation on Contractor's actual receipt of Owner payment, and Section 5.2 states Subcontractor bears the entire risk of Owner non-payment. This meets the glossary definition of pay_if_paid even though the words "condition precedent" are not used.

evidence.quote: Within seven (7) days after Contractor's receipt of payment from Owner that includes amounts for Subcontract Work
evidence.rationale: Section 5.4 states a seven-day period after Contractor receives Owner payment.

evidence.quote: The parties agree in writing to this seven (7) day payment period.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.4 expressly records written agreement to the seven-day period.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall withhold as retention five percent (5%) of each progress payment
evidence.rationale: Section 6.1 sets retention at 5% of each progress payment, which is 500 bps.

release_condition.value: Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

evidence.quote: Retention shall be released upon Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.2 states the two release events. Final Completion is defined as work completed and accepted in writing by Contractor, and Section 6.3 limits retention to Owner funds actually received.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor its retention within ten (10) days after both of those events have occurred
evidence.rationale: Section 6.2 sets ten days after both release events occur.

evidence.quote: With each application for progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor a conditional waiver and release on progress payment covering the full amount requested.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.1 requires a conditional release with each application.

evidence.quote: Within five (5) days after Subcontractor receives each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor an unconditional waiver and release on progress payment covering the amount received.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2 requires unconditional releases after each payment.

evidence.quote: With each payment application, Subcontractor shall also deliver conditional statutory releases from each of its sub-subcontractors and material suppliers
evidence.rationale: Section 7.4 requires conditional and unconditional releases from lower tiers.

evidence.quote: Every waiver and release delivered under this Subcontract must be in the form prescribed by California Civil Code sections 8132, 8134, 8136, and 8138
evidence.rationale: Section 7.3 requires the California statutory forms without modification.

evidence.quote: Contractor may deduct from any amount otherwise payable to Subcontractor under this Subcontract, or under any other agreement between the parties, all costs, damages, and expenses that Contractor incurs because of Subcontractor's failure to perform
evidence.rationale: Section 8.1 grants backcharge and setoff rights, including across other agreements.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount sufficient to cover the cost to correct Subcontract Work that is defective, nonconforming, or rejected by Owner, the architect, or a building official
evidence.rationale: Section 8.2 permits withholding for defective work. Section 8.3 adds other grounds, including claims and liens.

evidence.quote: Contractor will not pay for materials or equipment stored on or off the Project site.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.5 expressly excludes payment for stored materials.

anomalies.description: Pay-if-paid without the words "condition precedent". Subcontractor bears the entire risk of Owner non-payment, including insolvency. This applies to progress payments, retention and final payment.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor agrees that it shall be paid only out of funds actually received by Contractor from Owner for Subcontractor's work, and that Subcontractor bears the entire risk that Owner fails to pay for any reason including insolvency.
evidence.rationale: Pay-if-paid without the words "condition precedent". Subcontractor bears the entire risk of Owner non-payment, including insolvency. This applies to progress payments, retention and final payment.

anomalies.description: Payment is excused permanently if Owner never pays, including where Owner disputes with Contractor for reasons not caused by Subcontractor.

evidence.quote: If Owner never pays Contractor for some or all of the Subcontract Work, for any reason, including Owner's insolvency, bankruptcy, lack of funds, or dispute with Contractor not caused by Subcontractor, Contractor shall have no obligation to pay Subcontractor for that work.
evidence.rationale: Payment is excused permanently if Owner never pays, including where Owner disputes with Contractor for reasons not caused by Subcontractor.

anomalies.description: The progress payment amount is limited to what Owner actually paid for the work, not the amount approved on Subcontractor's application.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor the amount Owner paid for that work, less retention under Article 6 and any amounts withheld under Article 8.
evidence.rationale: The progress payment amount is limited to what Owner actually paid for the work, not the amount approved on Subcontractor's application.

anomalies.description: Retention release depends on Owner releasing retention and is payable only from Owner funds.

evidence.quote: Retention is a portion of the Subcontract Sum and is payable only from funds Contractor actually receives from Owner, as stated in Section 5.2.
evidence.rationale: Retention release depends on Owner releasing retention and is payable only from Owner funds.

anomalies.description: The release trigger "Final Completion" requires Contractor's written acceptance, which is a discretionary element.

evidence.quote: has been completed and accepted in writing by Contractor.
evidence.rationale: The release trigger "Final Completion" requires Contractor's written acceptance, which is a discretionary element.

anomalies.description: Unusual cross-contract setoff: Contractor may deduct amounts arising under other agreements between the parties.

evidence.quote: Contractor may deduct from any amount otherwise payable to Subcontractor under this Subcontract, or under any other agreement between the parties
evidence.rationale: Unusual cross-contract setoff: Contractor may deduct amounts arising under other agreements between the parties.

anomalies.description: Amounts withheld are repaid only subject to Article 5, meaning they also depend on Owner payment.

evidence.quote: When the grounds for withholding are removed, Contractor shall pay the amount withheld, subject to Article 5.
evidence.rationale: Amounts withheld are repaid only subject to Article 5, meaning they also depend on Owner payment.

anomalies.description: Final payment is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of Owner final payment, in addition to closeout and releases.

evidence.quote: (d) Contractor's receipt from Owner of final payment for the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Final payment is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of Owner final payment, in addition to closeout and releases.

anomalies.description: Payment on termination for convenience is also subject to the Article 5 Owner-payment condition.

evidence.quote: Payment under this Section is subject to Article 5.
evidence.rationale: Payment on termination for convenience is also subject to the Article 5 Owner-payment condition.

anomalies.description: No retention cap or reduction schedule is stated; retention stays at 5% throughout.
